allow_trim.description: Enables TRIM (discard) support on the mapped volume.

cipher.description: Specifies the cipher algorithm or cascade of ciphers to use for the outer volume.

device.description: Specifies the disk device on which the TrueCrypt volume resides.

hidden_cipher.description: Specifies the cipher algorithm for the hidden volume. If omitted, the outer volume cipher is used.

hidden_keyfiles.description: List of paths to keyfiles used for the hidden volume.

hidden_pbkdf_prf.description: Specifies the hash algorithm for the PBKDF2 password derivation for the hidden volume. If omitted, the outer volume PRF is used.

keyfiles.description: List of paths to keyfiles used in addition to the passphrase for the outer volume.

mapping.description: Specifies the logical name for the dm-crypt mapping.

pbkdf_prf.description: Specifies the hash algorithm for the PBKDF2 password derivation for the outer volume.

protect_hidden.description: Specifies that an outer volume will be mapped, but its reported size will be adjusted to protect the hidden volume.

system_device.description: Required if accessing a device using system encryption; points to the parent physical device.

use_backup.description: Forces tcplay to use backup headers located at the end of the device.
